capabilities: Propagate template changes into existing notes without losing their content
Write templates with the Nunjucks engine plus extra features
extras: The README links to a Documentation section that contains no inline content, so full usage details live elsewhere. The author also states the plugin is developed mostly without AI-assisted tools and rejects blatantly vibe-coded contributions.
intentEvidence: Blueprint is a templating plugin for Obsidian. It lets you propagate changes in your templates to your notes without losing content
problem: Standard templating inserts a one-time copy, so later edits to a template never reach notes already created from it.
summary: Nunjucks-based templating plugin whose templates stay linked to created notes, propagating template changes into them and pulling from frontmatter properties.
